integrity: The power spectrum follows directly from known orientation correlations and a harmonic filter; only the exact three-peak threshold, fold scaling and central-minimum region are assessed as an additional theorem. A plausible 2017 primary full text was unavailable and independent validation is outstanding.
scientific_limitations: Stationary 2D chiral active Brownian motion in a harmonic trap without translational diffusion. Complete peak counts for matched trap and rotational rates, plus an unequal-rate open central-minimum region; no full unequal-rate boundary phase diagram or experimental signal-to-noise claim.
title: Exact three-peak spectral onset for a harmonically confined chiral Brownian swimmer
